title: OCG Receipt Verifier
description: Fully offline, upload-driven verifier for OCG receipts: recomputes the execution_hash, verifies any eddsa-jcs-2022 Ed25519 audit_signature.proof, and checks RFC 6962 Merkle inclusion against an anchor_bindings entry. Snapshot-batch mode verifies many receipts against one uploaded checkpoint note. Zero network calls anywhere in the tool.

receipt.description: A single OCG artifact JSON to verify (single-receipt mode)

checkpoint_note.description: C2SP tlog-checkpoint note text (origin/size/root) for snapshot-batch mode

receipts.description: Multiple OCG artifacts to verify against one uploaded checkpoint (snapshot-batch mode)

verification_report.description: verdict, per-check pass/fail rows, recomputed_hash, signature verification, and anchor/merkle-inclusion results

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_ocg_receipt
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes an OCG receipt's execution_hash, verifies its eddsa-jcs-2022 signature (if present), and verifies RFC 6962 Merkle inclusion against an anchor binding or an uploaded checkpoint.
